historical_seeap_gcv.basis: GROSS CALORIFIC VALUE as printed (kcal/kg), NOT net calorific value; no toe-conversion claims; published as method reference ONLY
historical_seeap_gcv.note: Source Table 25 is reference heating value, not measured Kerala 2024–25 fuel quality; GCV cannot be silently used in NCV / IEA toe or IPCC emission calculations.

source_method_findings: June 2024 official report describes national-level transport/retail percentage applied to Kerala petrol and diesel, not fully metered year-by-year Kerala sector demand.
June 2024 source describes interpolations and FY-to-CY transforms, so annual emission outputs are not unprocessed fuel meter readings.
2023 portal is updated inventory; methodology and revisions relative to June 2024 PDF have not been resolved.
2023 inventory excludes power-import embodied generation emissions unless methodology explicitly establishes coverage; avoid asserting included or excluded from source absence.

crosswalk.reason: mass of sales by product vs calendar 2023 modelled emissions; emissions factors and end-use allocations are not directly identifiable
historic final-energy baseline, not 2023 carbon inventory and no original fuel×sector workbook
different year, spatial/sector and energy-carrier boundary, no double count conversion fuel or imports
report separately with scope, not a conversion of PPAC fuels into Mtoe
